command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
R=chr20:1000000-3000000
echo "== HaplotypeCaller on 2 Mb at 1 thread, then at 8 -- does threading do anything on arm64? =="
T0=$(date +%s)
gatk HaplotypeCaller -R chr20.fa -I NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -L $R --native-pair-hmm-threads 1 -O t1.vcf.gz > hc1.log 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s)
gatk HaplotypeCaller -R chr20.fa -I NA12878.chr20.30x.bam -L $R --native-pair-hmm-threads 8 -O t8.vcf.gz > hc8.log 2>&1
T2=$(date +%s)
S1=$(( T1 - T0 )); S8=$(( T2 - T1 ))
N1=$(zcat t1.vcf.gz | grep -vc '^#' || true)
N8=$(zcat t8.vcf.gz | grep -vc '^#' || true)
GKL=$(grep -c 'LOGLESS_CACHING' hc1.log || true)
NATIVE=$(grep -ci 'AVX.*not supported\|libgkl\|Intel GKL' hc1.log || true)
{
  echo "region              $R  (2,000,001 bp at ~33x)"
  echo "threads1_s          $S1"
  echo "threads8_s          $S8"
  echo "variants_1t         $N1"
  echo "variants_8t         $N8  (must equal variants_1t -- threads change speed, never the answer)"
  echo "mb_per_min_1t       $(awk -v s=$S1 'BEGIN{if(s>0)printf \"%.2f\", 2.0/(s/60)}')"
  echo "arm64_java_pairhmm  $GKL  (>=1 => Intel GKL AVX .so did not load, Java fallback in use)"
  echo "gkl_mentions        $NATIVE"
  echo "chr20_full_estimate_min  $(awk -v s=$S1 'BEGIN{printf \"%.0f\", (s/2.0)*64.444/60}')  (extrapolated at the 1-thread rate)"
} > canary.txt
cat canary.txt
echo '--- GKL / PairHMM lines from the log ---'
grep -iE 'pairhmm|gkl|avx|intel' hc1.log | head -12 | tee -a canary.txt
test "$N1" -eq "$N8"
test "$N1" -gt 100
echo 'CANARY DONE'
